question: Among Mexico resident-state SAEH admissions for gallstone (K80) versus broad urinary stone/renal colic (N20-N23) diagnoses, does the E3 association differ between ED-origin and outpatient-consultation-origin records?

interpretation.field_role: admission origin/procedencia of admission, not a surgical procedure code
interpretation.official_guide: DGIS SAEH Guía de Intercambio de Información, version 2.2 (2014), https://riisp.insp.mx/nada/files_nesstar/SAEH_SSA/Referencias/NOTAS_TECNICAS/GII-B002-SAEH-02-02.pdf
interpretation.extrapolation: The only annual origin catalog located in the local Mexico_DGIS archive is the 2019 bundle. Its field definition/code labels are applied to raw PROCED in source years 2015-2023; this stable-definition extrapolation is an explicit limitation and all raw code frequencies, including unrecognized and missing values, will be audited by source year.

analysis_classes.all_other_codes: retained separately; never classified as elective
analysis_classes.unknown: blank and unrecognized values retained in grouped source output and audit

interpretation.acute_presentation_limit: PROCED=2 is an ED-origin/acute-presentation proxy. It does not prove symptom onset, disease acuity, triage severity, or the causal mechanism of admission.
interpretation.TIPSERV: Type of service at admission. Retain the raw code; it is not an urgency/elective classifier.
interpretation.DIAS_ESTA: Recorded length of stay. Group as 0, 1-30, >30, or unknown; the sensitivity is described only as records with a recorded inpatient stay of 1-30 days, not as hospital certification.

cohort.retained_event_dates: All valid admission dates in 2015-2023 across the nine source-year files, including cross-source late prior admissions from source year 2023.

primary_model.calendar: separate full 2015-2022 daily calendar for each resident state; one all-origin common E3 spline basis and P95/median reference per state over that full eligible period
primary_model.fit: stacked endpoint-specific quasi-Poisson with separate disease-specific nuisance terms, no population offset
primary_model.covariance: calendar-date HAC with Bartlett lag 14 days
primary_model.primary_contrast: logRRR_ED_origin minus logRRR_outpatient_consultation_origin for (N20-N23 versus K80); report exponentiated contrast and 95% HAC interval
primary_model.interaction_test: joint 3-df Wald test for the difference-in-difference across all three E3 spline basis coefficients
primary_model.unit_inclusion: at least 30 events in each of the four endpoint cells and at least 400 E3-eligible calendar days
primary_model.pooling: country-state estimates pooled by DL and REML with Hartung-Knapp; report k, I2, concordance, failures, and code/coverage counts

supportive_models: N20-only versus K80 within ED-origin records, labeled a stricter acute-presentation proxy without onset/mechanism claims
Broad N20-N23 versus K80 within ED-origin records
Broad N20-N23 versus K80 within outpatient-consultation-origin records
single_additional_sensitivity: Repeat the broad four-endpoint ED-origin versus outpatient-consultation-origin model after restricting to records with DIAS_ESTA 1-30 days; label as a recorded 1-30-day stay sensitivity, not a validated hospital or admission classification.
reconciliation: For each source/event-date window and the combined 2015-2022 event-date cohort, compare all-origin state-day K80, K81, N20, N21, N22, and N23 counts exactly with data/mx_complete_source_state_day_2015_2022.csv. Preserve and audit every difference; do not tune source selection to force agreement.
prohibited_interpretations: PROCED=1 or any non-ED-origin code is not elective
N20-only is not proof of acute onset
The origin contrast is not proof of a disease mechanism
